incident.title: Sensitive account change shortly after sign-in

score_breakdown.reason: Sensitive account or admin change: account.password.changed

alerts.title: Sensitive account change shortly after sign-in
alerts.explanation: 1 x signin then 1 x change for user.id=u-1016 within 30m

timeline.description: [app-security] auth.signin.success (success), account u-1016, from 192.0.2.10, POST /api/auth/signin, client android/10203
[app-security] account.password.changed (success), account u-1016, from 192.0.2.10, PATCH /api/account, client android/10203
Alert PRH-ACCT-001 (high): Sensitive account change shortly after sign-in

recommended_actions: If the owner did not make the change: end all sessions, revert the change, reset the password and re-enable two-step verification.
Hold payouts to a newly changed payout number until the owner confirms it.
Consider requiring re-authentication or a confirmation code for these changes.
limitations: Enrichment not run: IP reputation and location were not considered
Single log source (app-security): no other log corroborates it
Possible benign cause for PRH-ACCT-001: The account owner changing their own settings after signing in
Possible benign cause for PRH-ACCT-001: Support staff helping a user recover an account
